sets.title: Kim: gold questions
sets.intro: Kim Sue-il (Kizuna Encounter), rebuilt the way Terry was. Every question: my proposal first, then the alternatives; NONE lets you say your own in the note. Each option plays its moves as small looping clips, left to right; tap a clip for quarter speed. Specials play whole, as they come out on a hit. You can also just answer in chat against the list below.
sets.proposal_title: My whole proposal (what each input does)
proposal: Size: scale 0.92 (a little taller than Terry, shorter than Krauser).
Chain (A A A A A): close A > close A > close C > down-forward C > close D (5 hits).
Last hit with forward: forward + B (the long lunge). With up: far C (launches). With down: down-forward D (crumples). With back: his throw.
Blitz (free): forward, forward + A = 236A; down, down + A = 214B; down, up + A = nothing; up, up + A = nothing.
C specials (1 drive chunk, invincible): C = [2]8C rising flip (also the combo breaker); forward + C = 236C rush; down + C = 421A lunge.
Fury (D) = 6246A. MAX (D at low life with the fury ready) = the same 6246A, stronger.
Air: forward jump + A = jump D; straight jump + A = jump C; down + A = j.2B dive (only flinches, hits until he lands).
Hit while holding the enemy: close B.
Animations: [2]8C, 421A, jump C, jump CD, down-forward D, 236A to check; far D and close D are one animation.
Walk back: his walk played backwards (Kizuna has none).

sets.title: Brawler revamp
sets.intro: Each question comes from the study of eight classic brawlers (Final Fight to Shadow over Mystara) and your principles. Tap the outcome you want; type or speak a note if it's "almost". Answers save as you go.

questions.title: Should a missed press restart the chain?
questions.context: All 8 games: a chain advances only on a hit; a whiff or being hit restarts it.
options: A whiff restarts the chain (as in all 8 games)

questions.title: How long after a hit can you press the next link?
questions.context: Captain Commando 16 f, Mystara 24, AvP 30, Dino 40, Punisher 50, Final Fight 45 (while idle).

questions.title: What happens to a press made during the hit freeze?
questions.context: Final Fight, Captain Commando, Punisher, Mystara: lost. Warriors of Fate, Dino: kept. Final Fight study: no buffer makes slow fighters feel stiff.
options: Kept, and it fires on the first possible frame (plus a 4 to 6 frame buffer)
Lost, like the early Capcom games

questions.title: Chain length across archetypes
questions.context: Final Fight 5/4/3 (heavy shorter). Later Capcom: 4 for all; AvP and Mystara give the fast fighter the longest chain.
options: Per archetype: fast 5, balanced 4, heavy 3 (Final Fight)

questions.title: Direction held on the last link
questions.context: Final Fight: back on the last press throws the enemy you hit. Your note: every chain serves a purpose (escape, turn-around, crowd).
options: Picks the branch for everyone: back = throw backwards, forward = launcher or push, neutral = finisher

questions.title: Your thrown enemy lands on another enemy
questions.context: Final Fight: that hit refills your chain credit (Haggar's jab, throw shortcut), almost certainly an accident.
options: It counts as your hit and refills the chain (keep the accident on purpose)

questions.title: How many archetypes?
questions.context: SOR2: Axel balanced, Blaze fast, Max heavy. Krauser as a wrestler.

questions.title: What makes a heavy fighter heavy?
questions.context: Final Fight shortens Haggar's chain; SOR2 keeps Max at 4 links with 1.5x damage and longer freezes, your favourite.
options: Same chain length, about 1.5x damage and a longer freeze (Max)

questions.title: The hit freeze
questions.context: Final Fight flat 6. SOR2: 4 + damage/4, max 8. AvP 3 to 13 per move. Punisher 7/9/10 plus a 6-frame victim shake.
options: Per move on one scale for all fighters: about 6 (jab) to 12 (finisher)
One flat value for every hit (Final Fight)

questions.title: Damage per hit
questions.context: Warriors of Fate and Dino add a random spread; the others use fixed values.

questions.title: When an enemy hits you
questions.context: SOR2 12 frames, Punisher 17, Captain Commando and AvP 26 plus untouchable, Final Fight 28.
options: Short stun (about 12 to 20 frames) plus a brief untouchable window
Same long stun as enemies (about 28 frames)

questions.title: What launches an enemy into the air?
questions.context: AvP: a stun meter fills with hits and the finisher always launches. Mystara: specific moves relaunch.

questions.title: The brake on juggles
questions.context: AvP caps air hits at 3 and speeds up the get-up. Mystara: every route ends in a dead-end move. Others: no juggles at all.
options: A hard cap of 3 air hits (AvP)
Routes end in a dead-end move (Mystara)
No juggles: downed enemies are untouchable

questions.title: The invincible special (attack + jump)
questions.context: All 8 games: costs life only when it touches (6 to 12); later games never let it kill you.
options: Costs life only on contact and never kills

questions.title: A missed command grab
questions.context: KOF98: a real 29 to 31 frame whiff, punishable. SS2: one invisible frame. Double Dragon: turns into a normal attack.
options: Always a visible, punishable whiff (about 24 to 30 frames, KOF)
Turns into a normal attack (Double Dragon)

questions.title: Can a command grab catch an enemy still reeling from a hit?
questions.context: KOF98 and Double Dragon: yes, so a chain can end in the grab. SS2: no.
options: Yes: a chain can end in a command grab

questions.title: How many enemies may attack you at once?
questions.context: None of the 8 games has a limit: 3 to 5 attackers on the same frame happen.

questions.title: The enemy's random wait before attacking
questions.context: Final Fight: a random 1 to 60 frame wait in plain stance (your "half second"), then a short wind-up.
options: Show a readable "ready" pose during the wait

questions.title: Enemy wind-up length
questions.context: Final Fight: 3 to 6 frames for light hits, 12 to 15 for knives and charges, 20 to 50 for special attacks.
options: Proportional to damage, like Final Fight
One length for every enemy attack

questions.title: A hidden difficulty rank
questions.context: 5 of the 8 games raise enemy aggression, damage or count as you play well, invisibly.
options: Only on the higher difficulty settings

questions.title: Where do you explore chains without a build?
questions.context: Preview in the Lab, then push into the running game.
options: The Lab and the phone Player

questions.title: How far may a source animation be stretched or squeezed?
questions.context: Retiming startup / active / recovery to fit the shared timings.
options: 0.5x to 2x, beyond that it needs a hand check
Any amount, I judge by eye
